samples.reason: This is a constrained generation task requiring strict adherence to explicit facts, ordering, word count, and tone. Plover outperforms Avocet on all relevant internal evals (Extraction & Retrieval, Summarization, Support Dialogue, and instruction following), and its trust-and-safety training suits the sensitive bereavement context.

The query is a constrained creative-generation task (tribute writing with strict ordering, length, and style constraints). Plover-235B scores measurably higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs. 82.7), and the difference is at the threshold of run-to-run variance rather than within it, favoring Plover. Additionally, the request’s explicit prohibitions on invented details and metaphors benefit from Plover’s stronger policy-and-moderation training.

The query demands rigorous instruction adherence (exact fact order, 50-word limit, prohibitions on metaphors and invented details) alongside concise creative generation. Plover-235B outperforms Avocet-235B on IFEval (89.8 vs 85.3), Summarization (86.4 vs 80.6), and Creative Generation (84.7 vs 82.7), making it better suited for this high-constraint task.

The query demands strict instruction following (exact facts, specific order, word limit, no inventions) and precise summarization. Plover materially outperforms Avocet on IFEval (89.8 vs 85.3), Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 79.2), and Summarization (86.4 vs 80.6), making it the stronger choice for this constrained, fidelity-critical task.

This aligns with Avocet's stated preference for well-specified tasks with clear success criteria, and the relevant Creative Generation capability difference between the two models falls within run-to-run variance.
